title: Owl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dancing Owl: round body, big eyes, wings out, feet in dance pose -->
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#F2D3A8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='20' fill='#7A4E2E'/>
  <!-- Ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='33,18 28,4 42,14' fill='#5E3A1E'/>
  <polygon points='67,18 72,4 58,14' fill='#5E3A1E'/>
  <!-- Eye discs -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='10' fill='#F7E7C8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='10' fill='#F7E7C8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='5' fill='#2B1B0E'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='5' fill='#2B1B0E'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='29' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='47,38 53,38 50,45' fill='#F0A630'/>
  <!-- Left wing raised -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='8' ry='16' fill='#6B4226' transform='rotate(-35 22 50)'/>
  <!-- Right wing raised -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='8' ry='16' fill='#6B4226' transform='rotate(35 78 50)'/>
  <!-- Wing tips -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='40' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#54331C' transform='rotate(-35 16 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='40' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#54331C' transform='rotate(35 84 40)'/>
  <!-- Left leg kicking out -->
  <rect x='36' y='84' width='5' height='10' fill='#F0A630' transform='rotate(-25 38 84)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='94' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#F0A630' transform='rotate(-15 32 94)'/>
  <!-- Right leg standing on tiptoe -->
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='5' height='10' fill='#F0A630' transform='rotate(20 60 86)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='97' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#F0A630' transform='rotate(15 70 97)'/>
  <!-- Dance motion sparkles -->
  <polygon points='12,62 14,68 20,70 14,72 12,78 10,72 4,70 10,68' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <polygon points='88,58 90,63 95,65 90,67 88,72 86,67 81,65 86,63' fill='#FFE066'/>
</svg>
